entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This application u/s 528 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (hereinafter referred to as 'Bnss')
has been filed with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings, including charge-sheet dated
21.12.2024 as well as cognizance / summoning order dated 06.02.2025, of Case No. 8287 of 2025
(State Vs. Rajjo @ Rajvati and others), arising out of Case Crime No.288 of 2024, under Sections
420, 406, 504, 506, 323 Ipc, P.S.- Dankaur, District- Gautam Buddha Nagar, pending in the court
of A.C.J.M.-Ist, Gautam Buddha Nagar.
Smt. Rajjo And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 July, 2025
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that the first information report has been lodged making false allegation.

It is further submitted that by impugned order dated 06.02.2025 applicants have been summoned for offence under Sections 420, 406 I.P.C. and as per law laid down in case of Delhi Race Club (1940) Ltd. and Others Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh and Another 2024 SCC Online SC 2248, the offence of cheating viz-a-viz criminal breach of trust are independent and distinct and both cannot exist simultaneously and on this account alone the impugned summoning order is liable to be set aside.
4. Perusal of record shows that by impugned order dated 06.02.2025 applicants have been summoned under Sections 420, 406 I.P.C., besides Sections 504, 506, 323 IPC.

entities.text: Delhi Race Club (1940) Ltd. and Others Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh and Another 2024 SCC Online SC 2248
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As stated above, in case of Delhi Race Club (supra), it has been held by the Hon'ble Apex Court that the offence of cheating viz-a-viz criminal breach of trust are independent and distinct and thus, the same cannot exist simultaneously in same set of facts and that they are antithetical to each other.
Thus, it is clear that impugned summoning order is not in accordance with law.

5. In view of the aforesaid, the impugned summoning order dated 06.02.2025, passed by the A.C.J.M.- Ist, Gautam Buddha Nagar is hereby set aside and the matter is remitted back to the court concerned to pass the order on the point of summoning afresh, expeditiously in accordance with law.
6. The application u/s 528 BNSS is finally disposed of in above terms.

Order Date :- 9.7.2025 'SP'/-
